self.title: When Should Independent Judgment Challenge Consensus?

detail.title: Independent Judgment vs Consensus
detail.question: When should an intelligent system trust its own conclusions over the consensus of other intelligences?
detail.reason: This project explores foundational questions about the reliability of consensus mechanisms versus independent analysis, directly addressing the selected topic.

detail.title: Formal Models of Epistemic Disagreement
detail.question: Under what conditions should an agent rely on individual evidence vs group consensus in Bayesian epistemology?
detail.reason: Initial inquiry into formal epistemic disagreement models requires accessible full-text or source-controlled material to support notebook synthesis.
